entries.normalizedText: build a comprehensive enterprise hr management system with automated workflows. # 1. core modules & entities - **department**: name, code, location, manager. - **employee**: first name, last name, email, job title, department (link), manager (link), status (active/terminated). # 2. recruitment module (ats) - **jobposting**: title, department (link), status (open/closed). - **candidate**: name, email, applied for (link to jobposting), status (new, interviewing, offer, hired, rejected). # 3. time off module - **leaverequest**: employee (link), start date, end date, type (vacation/sick), reason, status (pending, approved, rejected). # 4. performance module - **performancereview**: employee (link), review period, rating (1-5), comments, status (draft, submitted, finalized). # 5. required workflows (logic) please generate the "workflows" array for: 1. "leave approval flow": - trigger: when a leaverequest is created. - step 1: manager approval (user task). - step 2: hr notification (service task - email). 2. "candidate hiring flow": - trigger: when candidate status changes to "offer". - step 1: generate offer letter (service task). - step 2: vp approval (user task). # 6. pages - "hr dashboard": dashboard with counts of active employees and open jobs. - "recruitment board": kanban board for candidates grouped by status. - "leave portal": list of my leaverequests with a "create new" button. - "org chart": employee directory list
